method: Assistant inspection of actual native-cell coordinate previews; manually selected region boundaries and features; visible pixels split by those boundaries, widths/spans measured from masks; at most 1.5-cell feature snap to visible cells. Touching-part boundaries have about one-cell uncertainty. Not automatic semantic recognition or human approval.

review.reviewer: Codex artwork inspection; no user approval
observations: The teal core, cream eye, copper vanes and violet tail remain recognizable across all six frames.
The tail jumps between left and right silhouettes; the high pose to following pose and the loop need timing review.
Core facet patterns and the eye placement change across poses. Vane and tail visible areas need redraw or justified occlusion review.
The exported 64-cell art is a fixed projection of a nongrid raw image. Uniform output cells do not prove raw pixel quality.
